episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the evolving landscape of luxury real estate, driven by AI wealth and lifestyle optimization. She shares insights on leveraging AI for branding and client engagement, and offers strategies for winning in competitive offer situations. The conversation highlights the importance of personal relationships and adapting to new market trends.
